SPECIMEN: Cervical lymph node, excision
FINDINGS: Diffuse effacement by large atypical lymphoid cells; CD20+, PAX5+, CD10-, BCL6+, MUM1+, BCL2+, MYC 20%, CD5-, EBER-; Ki-67 70%; MYC/BCL2/BCL6 FISH pending.

Cervical lymph node, excision:
- DIFFUSE LARGE B-CELL LYMPHOMA, NOS, PENDING MYC/BCL2/BCL6 FISH.

Sections show diffuse effacement by large atypical lymphoid cells. The atypical cells are positive for CD20, PAX5, BCL6, MUM1, and BCL2, and negative for CD10, CD5, and EBER. MYC is expressed in 20% of cells. Ki-67 is approximately 70%.

COMMENT
The findings support diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. MYC/BCL2/BCL6 FISH studies are pending.

SPECIMEN: Inguinal lymph node, excision
FINDINGS: Back-to-back follicles composed of centrocytes and scattered centroblasts; CD20+, CD10+, BCL6+, BCL2+ within follicles; CD21 highlights follicular dendritic cell meshworks; Ki-67 20%.

Inguinal lymph node, excision:
- FOLLICULAR LYMPHOMA, CLASSIC TYPE.

Sections show closely packed atypical follicles composed predominantly of centrocytes with scattered centroblasts. The follicles are positive for CD20, CD10, BCL6, and BCL2. CD21 highlights follicular dendritic cell meshworks. Ki-67 is approximately 20%.

COMMENT
The findings support classic follicular lymphoma.

SPECIMEN: Axillary lymph node, core biopsy
FINDINGS: Small mature lymphocytes with proliferation centres; CD20+, CD5+, CD23+, LEF1+, cyclin D1-, CD10-; Ki-67 10% outside proliferation centres.

Axillary lymph node, core biopsy:
- CHRONIC LYMPHOCYTIC LEUKEMIA/SMALL LYMPHOCYTIC LYMPHOMA.

Sections show a diffuse infiltrate of small mature lymphocytes with focal proliferation centres. The lymphoid cells are positive for CD20, CD5, CD23, and LEF1, and negative for cyclin D1 and CD10. Ki-67 is approximately 10% outside the proliferation centres.

COMMENT
The findings support chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

SPECIMEN: Cervical lymph node, excision
FINDINGS: Monomorphic small to medium lymphocytes; CD20+, CD5+, cyclin D1+, SOX11+, CD23-, CD10-; Ki-67 30%.

Cervical lymph node, excision:
- MANTLE CELL LYMPHOMA.

Sections show a diffuse infiltrate of relatively monomorphic small to medium-sized lymphoid cells. The cells are positive for CD20, CD5, cyclin D1, and SOX11, and negative for CD23 and CD10. Ki-67 is approximately 30%.

COMMENT
The morphologic and immunophenotypic findings support mantle cell lymphoma.

SPECIMEN: Gastric biopsy
FINDINGS: Dense infiltrate of small B cells with lymphoepithelial lesions; CD20+, PAX5+, CD5-, CD10-, cyclin D1-; kappa-restricted plasma cells.

Gastric biopsy:
- EXTRANODAL MARGINAL ZONE LYMPHOMA OF MUCOSA-ASSOCIATED LYMPHOID TISSUE (MALT LYMPHOMA).

Sections show a dense infiltrate of small atypical lymphocytes with lymphoepithelial lesions. The lymphoid cells are positive for CD20 and PAX5, and negative for CD5, CD10, and cyclin D1. The associated plasma cells show kappa light-chain restriction.

COMMENT
The findings support extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue.

SPECIMEN: Mediastinal lymph node, core biopsy
FINDINGS: Large atypical cells in inflammatory background; CD30+, CD15+, PAX5 weak+, CD20-, CD45-, EBER-.

Mediastinal lymph node, core biopsy:
- CLASSIC HODGKIN LYMPHOMA.

Sections show scattered large atypical lymphoid cells in a mixed inflammatory background. The large cells are positive for CD30 and CD15, show weak PAX5 expression, and are negative for CD20, CD45, and EBER.

COMMENT
The findings support classic Hodgkin lymphoma. Subclassification is limited by the core biopsy.

SPECIMEN: Tonsil, biopsy
FINDINGS: Sheets of intermediate-sized lymphocytes, starry-sky pattern; CD20+, CD10+, BCL6+, BCL2-, TdT-; Ki-67 100%; MYC FISH pending.

Tonsil, biopsy:
- AGGRESSIVE B-CELL LYMPHOMA, PENDING MYC FISH.

Sections show sheets of intermediate-sized atypical lymphoid cells with frequent apoptotic debris and a starry-sky appearance. The cells are positive for CD20, CD10, and BCL6, and negative for BCL2 and TdT. Ki-67 is approximately 100%.

COMMENT
The findings raise consideration of Burkitt lymphoma. MYC FISH is pending for definitive classification.

SPECIMEN: Skin, punch biopsy
FINDINGS: Dense dermal infiltrate of large atypical B cells; CD20+, PAX5+, BCL2+, MUM1+, CD10-, CD3-; Ki-67 80%.

Skin, punch biopsy:
- LARGE B-CELL LYMPHOMA, FURTHER CLASSIFICATION REQUIRES CLINICAL CORRELATION.

Sections show a dense dermal infiltrate of large atypical lymphoid cells. The cells are positive for CD20, PAX5, BCL2, and MUM1, and negative for CD10 and CD3. Ki-67 is approximately 80%.

COMMENT
The findings support a large B-cell lymphoma. Correlation with clinical distribution and staging is required for classification.

SPECIMEN: Axillary lymph node, core biopsy
FINDINGS: Preserved follicles with polarized germinal centres; CD20+ B follicles, CD3+ interfollicular T cells; germinal centres CD10+, BCL6+, BCL2-; CD21 FDC meshworks; Ki-67 80% in germinal centres.

Axillary lymph node, core biopsy:
- Reactive follicular hyperplasia.

Sections show preserved lymphoid architecture with polarized germinal centres and intact mantle zones. CD20 highlights B-cell follicles and CD3 highlights interfollicular T cells. Germinal centres are positive for CD10 and BCL6 and negative for BCL2. CD21 highlights follicular dendritic cell meshworks. Ki-67 is approximately 80% in germinal centres.

COMMENT
The findings support reactive follicular hyperplasia. No evidence of lymphoma is identified.

SPECIMEN: Colon polyp, biopsy
FINDINGS: Dense small lymphoid infiltrate; mixed CD20+ B cells and CD3+ T cells, slightly more B than T; deeper levels exhausted; cyclin D1, CD10, BCL6, BCL2 uninterpretable.

Colon polyp, biopsy:
- Atypical lymphoid infiltrate.

Sections show a dense infiltrate of relatively monotonous small lymphocytes. CD20 and CD3 highlight mixed B- and T-cell populations, with slightly more B cells than T cells. Assessment of cyclin D1, CD10, BCL6, and BCL2 is significantly limited by tissue exhaustion.

COMMENT
A B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder cannot be excluded. Repeat biopsy with fresh tissue for flow cytometry may be considered if clinically indicated.

SPECIMEN: Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy
FINDINGS: Cellularity 60%; increased large mature hyperlobulated megakaryocytes in loose clusters; no significant reticulin fibrosis (MF-0); blasts 1%; persistent thrombocytosis; JAK2 V617F positive.

Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy:
- Myeloproliferative neoplasm, favour essential thrombocythemia.

The marrow is mildly hypercellular (60%) with increased large, mature megakaryocytes showing hyperlobulated nuclei and loose clustering. Blasts comprise 1% of aspirate nucleated cells. Reticulin fibrosis is not increased (MF-0).

COMMENT
The history of persistent thrombocytosis and JAK2 V617F mutation is noted. The findings favour essential thrombocythemia, subject to clinical and laboratory correlation.

SPECIMEN: Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy
FINDINGS: Cellularity 90%; granulocytic and megakaryocytic proliferation, atypical megakaryocytes in dense clusters; MF-2; blasts 2%; JAK2 V617F positive.

Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy:
- Myeloproliferative neoplasm with increased marrow fibrosis.

The marrow is markedly hypercellular (90%) with granulocytic and megakaryocytic proliferation. Megakaryocytes show nuclear atypia and dense clustering. Reticulin fibrosis is increased (MF-2). Blasts comprise 2% of aspirate nucleated cells.

COMMENT
The findings support a myeloproliferative neoplasm with increased fibrosis. Correlation with blood counts, clinical history, and prior marrow findings is required for definitive subclassification.

SPECIMEN: Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy
FINDINGS: Cellularity 50%; erythroid dysplasia 20%, megakaryocytic dysplasia 15%; blasts 3%; SF3B1 mutation positive; cytogenetics pending.

Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy:
- Myelodysplastic neoplasm with low blasts, pending integrated classification.

The marrow is approximately 50% cellular with dysplasia involving the erythroid and megakaryocytic lineages. Blasts comprise 3% of aspirate nucleated cells.

COMMENT
An SF3B1 mutation is reported. Final classification requires correlation with mutation characteristics, cytogenetic findings, and applicable diagnostic criteria. Cytogenetic studies are pending.

SPECIMEN: Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy
FINDINGS: Cellularity 80%; blasts 35%; CD34+, CD117+, MPO+; flow confirms abnormal myeloid blasts; NPM1 mutation detected.

Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy:
- ACUTE MYELOID LEUKEMIA WITH NPM1 MUTATION.

The marrow is hypercellular (80%) and extensively involved by blasts comprising 35% of aspirate nucleated cells. Blasts are positive for CD34, CD117, and MPO. Flow cytometry identifies an abnormal myeloid blast population.

COMMENT
The findings support acute myeloid leukemia with NPM1 mutation.

SPECIMEN: Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy
FINDINGS: Cellularity 40%; plasma cells 25% by CD138; lambda restricted; CD56+, cyclin D1-; imaging and myeloma-defining events not supplied.

Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy:
- PLASMA CELL NEOPLASM INVOLVING BONE MARROW (25% PLASMA CELLS).

The marrow is approximately 40% cellular with increased plasma cells comprising approximately 25% of marrow cellularity by CD138. The plasma cells show lambda light-chain restriction, are positive for CD56, and negative for cyclin D1.

COMMENT
Correlation with serum and urine studies, free light chains, imaging, and clinical findings is required for definitive classification.

SPECIMEN: Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy
FINDINGS: Cellularity 70%; paratrabecular aggregates of small cleaved lymphocytes 15% marrow; CD20+, CD10+, BCL6+, BCL2+; CD21 FDC meshworks; known follicular lymphoma.

Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy:
- BONE MARROW INVOLVEMENT BY FOLLICULAR LYMPHOMA (15%).

The marrow is hypercellular (70%) with paratrabecular lymphoid aggregates comprising approximately 15% of marrow cellularity. The lymphoid cells are positive for CD20, CD10, BCL6, and BCL2. CD21 highlights follicular dendritic cell meshworks.

COMMENT
The findings are consistent with marrow involvement by the patient's known follicular lymphoma.

- Marrow examination limited by hemodilute aspirate.

SPECIMEN: Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy
FINDINGS: Cellularity 85%; diffuse small lymphoid infiltrate 60%; CD20+, CD5+, CD23+, LEF1+, cyclin D1-; peripheral blood lymphocytosis.

Bone marrow, aspirate and trephine biopsy:
- BONE MARROW INVOLVEMENT BY CHRONIC LYMPHOCYTIC LEUKEMIA/SMALL LYMPHOCYTIC LYMPHOMA (60%).

The marrow is hypercellular (85%) with a diffuse infiltrate of small mature lymphocytes comprising approximately 60% of marrow cellularity. The lymphoid cells are positive for CD20, CD5, CD23, and LEF1, and negative for cyclin D1.

COMMENT
The findings support marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma. Peripheral blood lymphocytosis is noted.
